scope: Individual singles champions; WTA Tour, historical Tour levels, WTA 125 and Grand Slams
order: Tournament end date, oldest first; this is not necessarily the actual final match date
coverage_note: Available records within the requested date range. Historical events labelled ITF in the WTA calendar are included only when the official WTA singles player records verify a Tour title in that season. Records marked explicitly ITF are excluded from historical candidate discovery. Coverage depends on WTA's published records; this does not assert a complete history of every title. Cancelled, unfinished, team and Olympic events are excluded. Unavailable champions are listed separately.
